item.text: {"paper_id":"paper162","profile_id":"oncology","relevance":3,"evidence_quote":"ENPP3 overexpression accelerated tumor growth, while its knockdown or antibody blockade inhibited progression and synergized with anti-PD-L1.","rationale":"The study directly addresses molecular mechanisms of ccRCC progression, ENPP3 as a prognostic biomarker, and experimental antibody treatment that activates anti-tumor immunity and enhances anti-PD-L1 efficacy.","scope_ambiguous":false,"ambiguity_note":""}
